title: Filing: the SEC approved a Nasdaq rule change allowing some securities to trade in tokenized form; the new approach will be tested in an upcoming pilot program (The Block)
summary: The Block: Filing: the SEC approved a Nasdaq rule change allowing some securities to trade in tokenized form; the new approach will be tested in an upcoming pilot program — Quick Take — Eligible participants will be able to settle trades in tokenized form during a pilot program operated by the Depository Trust Company.
